replay_cases.mechanic: Betrayal real MV0 cascade hit, opponent library creature PUT not CAST
Betrayal casts but opponent library holds no creature
Countering Betrayal after cast does not untrigger Lost
Drannith stops betrayal exile cast and its triggered payoffs
Rule of Law stops betrayal free cast after the hand Ignus spell
Preferred Keeper plus actual MV1/MV0 low hit, 1/0 targeted damage

Loyal Subordinate 3 each opponent before second main => X9 at hand cast, 2 printed plus 1 granted, three physical free casts MV1/2/2 => 5 damage to each opposing creature; three Lost tokens; one skipped physical Swamp returns to library bottom.

Preexisting Keeper (6) + Kessig Flamebreather (1) attack unblocked => X7; only two printed cascades at Call cast. Keeper trigger after Sol Ring resolves can raise X to 8, but no third cascade is retroactively added.
Preexisting Keeper (6) + Storm-Kiln Artist (2) attack unblocked => X8 at Call cast, three cascades. Physical source-paid MV8.
No opponent lost life this turn => Abaddon does not grant; printed double cascade still occurs, damage3 across two actual free casts.
Abaddon granted at X9; three cascade abilities exile and bottom cards, but Drannith prevents any nonhand free cast; no Lost tokens or contribution from hits.
Call hand cast consumes Rule of Law's one spell; printed and granted cascade exiles cards yet cannot cast hits; source spell still deals zero to opponent creatures if no previous spell this turn.
Opponent counters the Call source spell before cascades resolve; pending three abilities still cascade-cast hits, but Call itself never resolves/deals creature damage.
Prior physically sourced and cast Boltwave MV1 caused 9 life loss; 3 actual physical cascade hits add 1+2+2; Call deals 6 damage to each opposing creature. Pure copy of spell (not cast) excluded.

True physical suspend cost paid, three separate upkeeps 3→2→1→0, conditional optional cast from exile in upkeep not constrained by sorcery timing. Creatures put not cast; Lost token from Betrayal cast.
Search may deliberately or necessarily fail to find a creature; spell cast and Lost triggers, no creature moved to battlefield.
Drannith disallows cast from exile after 3rd upkeep, card stays exiled with zero counters and cannot re-trigger on future upkeep.
A spell already cast on the final upkeep under Rule of Law prevents the suspend cast; card stranded in exile with zero counters.
Under 2024+ rules last-counter ability permits owner to decline casting; card remains exiled without counters, despite legal target.
Cast from exile generates Lost spawn; an opponent counters actual spell, it moves to graveyard, no creature enters.

A card with no mana cost cannot be normally cast from hand; suspending is not spell cast and does not increase storm/cascade; a later upkeep free cast if legal is first spell of that turn and has MV0; Keeper trigger would deal zero damage if Keeper present.

Paid Breach plus two genuinely escaped LED/Brain Freeze iterations: 5 casts, storm 2 then 4 copies, self-mill physical 6 cards, opponent requested mill 18, 12 exact physical escape-fodder cards exiled, mana pool net +2 U and actual 99 names conserved; conditional not unbounded.

After four escape casts exactly 12 OTHER physical cards exiled, never the escaped card itself, LED/Brain Freeze remain graveyard after their respective resolution, valid self-milled cards may become later fodder.
LED cannot legally escape with fewer than three OTHER graveyard cards even when its mana cost is 0; do not conjure cards or implicitly pay later.
LED activation discards every physically sourced hand card, creates UUU as mana ability (no stack), and cannot be used retroactively to pay the already performed Breach-from-hand casting cost.
If LED adds RRR and no separate U is available, Brain Freeze escape fails its {1}{U} mana portion despite adequate graveyard fodder.
With Rule of Law, Breach cast from hand is spell one; no further escaped LED/Brain Freeze spell cast allowed this turn.
Opponent-controlled Drannith Magistrate prevents casting escape spells from graveyard, even with Breach present and mana/fodder.

LED activation grants UUU immediately (no stack), but opponent removing Breach before next spell cast revokes escape permission; mana remains floating until used/phase ends. No automatic response to LED mana ability itself.

Countering original escaped Brain Freeze after storm trigger has resolved does not counter already-created spell copies; their separately targeted mill still resolves, original remains in graveyard, copied spells are not cast.
